output.selection_summary: Select exact asset-report:USOIL version 4 for a substantive dated document-led analysis. Anchor its public claim lineage and original EIA evidence, explain the import/product-stock countercase, distinguish observations from Main conditional interpretation, and retain missing current-market and execution data as clear limits.

ordered_candidate_plan.evidence_plan: Lead with the current accepted immutable Main public manifest and its exact asset-report:USOIL version 4 projection, dated 2026-10-19T09:14:42.517584Z. Preserve exact public-safe usoil-source and usoil-mechanism lineage; keep UKOIL version 2 and gas reports separate, not additional independent confirmations. Through existing source tooling bind retained original EIA petroleum bytes and the parent-recovered Neo capture to exact release/observation dates, capture timestamp and hashes. The reported fresh Neo read at 2026-10-20T15:01:31.829Z recovers the retained week-ending October 9 evidence; it is not a new release date or current-market claim. Bind the 8.6 million barrel draw to 415.6 million barrels, gasoline build, distillate draw, import decline, refinery utilization and four-week gasoline product-supplied comparison to exact source passages. Keep the source wording product supplied as a demand proxy, not direct final-consumption measurement. Code owns extraction, unit checks and arithmetic; do not subtract a daily import rate directly from a weekly stock change or claim it fully explains the draw. Develop the causal alternatives: lower imports and refinery throughput can draw crude without stronger end demand; gasoline accumulation and the four-week year-on-year comparison test a simplistic demand-led reading, while lower crude and distillate stocks can still indicate tighter availability. Attribute Main qualitative interpretation as conditional analysis and EIA observations independently; the Main report is not external confirmation of its own mechanism. Retain dated report horizons only as conditional watch contexts, not forecasts, probabilities or trading instructions. Confirmation requires subsequent crude/product balances, normalized import/export flows, current WTI curve and separately captured pre-release expectations; invalidate the analytical watch if later balances reverse tightening or required evidence remains unavailable. Explicit gaps are contemporaneous prices/curve, expectations, broker basis, executable quote, spread, financing/carry and costs; the September 22 price panel predates the release and cannot prove reaction. No private Main requests, new proprietary numbers, forecast or publication authority. The value is a substantive dated document analysis, not a fabricated fresh update.
ordered_candidate_plan.angle: The USOIL crude draw needs a demand test: read Main public report version 4 against the retained EIA import decline, gasoline build and four-week product-supplied measure before treating lower crude stocks as sustained end-demand strength.
ordered_candidate_plan.selection_rationale: The exact USOIL v4 candidate now matches the owner request and supplies a meaningful tension between a crude draw and a demand-led interpretation. The import and product-stock countercase, plus explicit confirmation and invalidation conditions, create reader utility beyond a headline recap. One exact report candidate is sufficient; adding Brent or gas as fallbacks would dilute the assigned USOIL analysis.
